synopsis: Chapter 10 lists ASME V&V 20 among standards and guides spanning various domains [f8154]. The glossary identifies it as an American Society of Mechanical Engineers verification and validation standard for fluid-flow and heat-transfer models, emphasizing computation of validation uncertainty [f14616, f14619]. However, both Chapter 10 and the glossary explicitly say the research did not verify ASME V&V 20, so its inclusion should not be treated as a verified basis for the booklet’s simulation-trust recommendations [f7632, f14623].

relations.note: Both explicitly report that ASME V&V 10 and 20 were not verified.
Identifies the issuing organization and model domains of the listed ASME standards.
Adds V&V 20’s emphasis on computing validation uncertainty.
Specifies the domain and uncertainty emphasis of a standard listed in Chapter 10.
